predicates.label: Task title
predicates.description: What the owner said, as captured or reworded with approval

predicates.label: Task state
predicates.description: GTD state: inbox, next, waiting, someday, done or dropped

predicates.label: Next action
predicates.description: The very next physical action, starting with a verb

predicates.label: Area
predicates.description: Area of the owner's life the task belongs to (created by the owner)

predicates.label: Context
predicates.description: Where or with what the task can be done

predicates.label: Project
predicates.description: GTD project: an outcome that needs more than one action

predicates.label: Due
predicates.description: When it is due; a date without time is stored at noon local time

predicates.label: Due has a time
predicates.description: Whether the due includes a time of day

predicates.label: Energy
predicates.description: Energy it needs: low, medium or high

predicates.label: Waiting on
predicates.description: Who or what the task is waiting for

predicates.label: Recurrence
predicates.description: Rule for the next occurrence (daily, weekly:mon, monthly:1, monthly:last-fri, yearly:MM-DD, days:N)

predicates.label: Series schedule
predicates.description: The scheduled date of this occurrence of a recurring task; postponing does not move it

predicates.label: Series has a time
predicates.description: Whether the recurring schedule includes a time of day

predicates.label: Times postponed
predicates.description: How many times the due date was moved

predicates.label: About task
predicates.description: The task an event is about

predicates.label: Days from due
predicates.description: When a task was completed relative to its due date: positive is late

predicates.label: Reason
predicates.description: Why something was postponed or dropped, in the owner's words
